apps.name: Central MariaDB
apps.description: Shared MariaDB. All apps use this instead of individual DBs.

apps.name: Central PostgreSQL
apps.description: Shared PostgreSQL. All apps use this instead of individual DBs.

education.quick_start: ownCloud gives you a private file sync & share platform. After install, visit the app URL and log in with admin/admin. Upload files, share links, and sync with desktop/mobile clients.
setup_steps: Log in with admin / admin
Go to Settings → Admin → set a secure admin password
Configure email server for password resets
Install desktop sync client from owncloud.com

education.quick_start: n8n is a workflow automation tool that connects apps together. After install, create an account, then build workflows by dragging and connecting 400+ integrations.
setup_steps: Open the app URL → create your account (first user is owner)
Explore the template library for ready-made workflows
Connect your apps via the integrations panel
Set up the n8n desktop app for local triggers

education.quick_start: Pi-hole blocks ads across your entire network at the DNS level. After install, set the admin password, configure upstream DNS, then point your router's DNS to this machine.
setup_steps: Set admin password: docker exec -it app-pihole pihole -a -p
Visit http://localhost:PORT/admin/ and log in
Check the Query Log to see blocked ads
Set your router's DNS to this machine's IP for network-wide blocking

apps.name: Open WebUI
apps.description: Self-hosted AI chat interface for LLMs

education.quick_start: Open WebUI is a ChatGPT-like interface for local LLMs. Connect it to Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible API to chat with AI models privately.
setup_steps: Open the app → create your admin account
Go to Settings → Connections → add your Ollama endpoint
Browse and pull models from the model library
Start chatting with your local AI

apps.name: CrewAI Studio
apps.description: Streamlit-based visual interface to build and orchestrate multi-agent crews without code.

education.quick_start: CrewAI Studio lets you build and run AI agent crews with a visual interface. Define agents, assign tasks, and watch them collaborate.
setup_steps: Open the app → create your account
Define your first AI agent (role, goal, backstory)
Create a task for the agent
Assemble a crew and run it

apps.name: Hermes Agent
apps.description: An open-source, persistent, self-improving autonomous AI agent developed by Nous Research.

education.quick_start: Hermes Agent is an AI agent from Nous Research. Note: This is a very large download (several GB) that includes AI models.
setup_steps: The image is large (>5GB) — first pull may take 5-10 minutes
Once running, the agent provides an API for AI tasks
Check the logs for access instructions: docker logs app-hermes-agent

apps.name: AdGuard Home
apps.description: Network-wide ad blocking and DNS filtering

education.quick_start: AdGuard Home is a network-wide ad blocker similar to Pi-hole. It runs a DNS server that filters ads before they reach any device.
setup_steps: Open http://localhost:PORT/ — the setup wizard will appear
Set up your admin credentials
Configure upstream DNS (Cloudflare, Google, etc.)
Point your router's DNS to this machine's IP

education.quick_start: WordPress is the world's most popular CMS. After install, the setup wizard will guide you through creating your site — choose a language, set up your database (already configured), and create your admin account.
setup_steps: Open the app URL → WordPress setup wizard will appear
Select your language and click Continue
Enter a Site Title, Username, and Password
Your site is ready! Visit /wp-admin to manage it

apps.name: Nextcloud
apps.description: Self-hosted file sync, calendar, contacts, office suite

education.quick_start: Nextcloud is a self-hosted productivity platform with file sync, calendar, contacts, and collaborative office tools. Create an admin account, then configure storage and users.
setup_steps: Open the app URL → create your admin account
Choose 'Install Recommended Apps' for full functionality
Install desktop/mobile sync clients from nextcloud.com
Set up calendar & contacts sync

education.quick_start: OnlyOffice Document Server provides online document editing (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) that integrates with Nextcloud, ownCloud, and other platforms.
setup_steps: This is a backend service — it works with Nextcloud/ownCloud apps
Install the ONLYOFFICE connector plugin in your cloud platform
Configure the connector to point to http://app-onlyoffice:PORT/
Test by creating/editing a document in your cloud

education.quick_start: GitLab is a complete DevOps platform with Git repos, CI/CD, and project management. After install, set the root password, then create projects and configure runners.
setup_steps: Open the app URL → set the root password
Log in with root and your chosen password
Create your first project
Add SSH keys in Preferences → SSH Keys

education.quick_start: BookStack is a self-hosted wiki/documentation platform. Organize content into Shelves → Books → Chapters → Pages hierarchy.
setup_steps: Log in with admin@admin.com / password
Change the default credentials immediately
Create your first Shelf → Book → Page
Configure SMTP for email notifications

education.quick_start: Paperless-ngx automatically organizes your documents. Drop PDFs into the consumption folder, and it tags, dates, and indexes them for search.
setup_steps: Open the app → create your superuser account
Configure the consumption folder for auto-importing
Set up document types and correspondents
Install the mobile app for scanning on the go

education.quick_start: Jellyfin is a media server for movies, TV, music, and photos. After setup, add your media libraries and enjoy on any device.
setup_steps: Open the app URL → complete the setup wizard
Add your media folders (Movies, TV Shows, Music)
Wait for the library scan to complete
Install Jellyfin clients on your TV, phone, or tablet

education.quick_start: Navidrome is a personal music streaming server. Point it to your music folder and stream your collection from anywhere.
setup_steps: Place your music files in the music volume
Open the app — Navidrome will scan automatically
Log in and start streaming
Use Subsonic-compatible apps (Ultrasonic, DSub) for mobile access

education.quick_start: Kavita is a self-hosted digital library for comics, manga, ebooks, and magazines. It supports CBR, CBZ, EPUB, PDF, and more.
setup_steps: Log in with admin / admin
Go to Settings → Libraries → Add your media folders
Set up the library scanner
Start reading in your browser or mobile app

education.quick_start: PhotoPrism is an AI-powered photo manager. It automatically organizes your photos by date, location, and even detects faces and objects.
setup_steps: Open the app → set your admin password
Point PhotoPrism to your photo directory
Let the indexing run (may take time for large libraries)
Explore the map view, albums, and search

education.quick_start: Immich is a Google Photos alternative for your phone. Auto-backup photos, search by objects/faces, and share albums.
setup_steps: Open the app → create your admin account
Install the Immich mobile app from the app store
Enable auto-backup on your phone
Wait for ML-powered search indexing (face detection, object recognition)

education.quick_start: WireGuard is a modern, fast VPN. Create a VPN server to securely access your home network from anywhere.
setup_steps: Configure WireGuard by editing config files in the volume
Generate client configs: docker exec -it app-wireguard /app/show-peer
Import the config file into the WireGuard client app
Connect and test your VPN

education.quick_start: Vaultwarden is a self-hosted Bitwarden-compatible password manager. Store, generate, and sync passwords across all devices.
setup_steps: Open the app → create your account
Install the Bitwarden browser extension
Configure the extension to use your self-hosted server URL
Install the Bitwarden mobile app and connect to your server

education.quick_start: Nginx Proxy Manager provides a web UI for managing Nginx reverse proxies, SSL certificates, and access lists.
setup_steps: Log in with admin@example.com / changeme
Change the admin email and password immediately
Add your first Proxy Host (domain → internal service)
Request SSL certificates via Let's Encrypt

education.quick_start: Traefik is a cloud-native reverse proxy and load balancer with automatic SSL. It auto-detects Docker containers and routes traffic.
setup_steps: Traefik is configured via Docker labels on other containers
Access the dashboard at http://localhost:PORT/dashboard/
Add labels to your containers to enable routing
Configure Let's Encrypt for automatic SSL

education.quick_start: Uptime Kuma monitors your services and sends alerts when they go down. Add monitors for HTTP, Ping, Port, DNS, and more.
setup_steps: Open the app → create your admin account
Click 'Add Monitor' to monitor your first service
Configure notification methods (Email, Telegram, Slack, etc.)
Set up the status page for public display

education.quick_start: Portainer provides a web UI for managing Docker containers, images, volumes, and networks. It's the easiest way to manage Docker.
setup_steps: Open the app → set your admin password (min 8 chars)
Select your Docker environment (local socket)
Explore the dashboard — containers, images, volumes
Use Portainer's App Templates to quickly deploy services

education.quick_start: Dozzle is a real-time Docker log viewer. See logs from all your containers in one browser window with search and filtering.
setup_steps: Open the app → see live logs from all running containers
Click any container to see its logs
Use the search bar to filter log entries
Bookmark specific containers for quick access

education.quick_start: Code-server runs VS Code in your browser. Access your development environment from any device with a full VS Code experience.
setup_steps: Open the app → enter the password shown in container logs
Install extensions from the VS Code marketplace
Open a terminal and start coding
Configure settings sync across devices

education.quick_start: Gitea is a lightweight Git service. Create repositories, manage issues, and collaborate with pull requests — like GitHub but self-hosted.
setup_steps: Open the app → the setup page will appear
Configure your Gitea instance (DB is already set up)
Create your admin account
Create your first repository and push code

apps.name: Stirling-PDF
apps.description: A robust, local-first web application that allows you to perform various operations on PDF files (merge, split, OCR, convert).

education.quick_start: Stirling PDF is a tool for manipulating PDFs — merge, split, convert, compress, and more. All processing happens locally.
setup_steps: Open the app → see the full PDF toolset
Upload a PDF and choose an operation
Download the result
No configuration needed — just use it

apps.name: Excalidraw
apps.description: Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams.

education.quick_start: Excalidraw is a whiteboard tool for sketching diagrams. Draw flowcharts, wireframes, and diagrams with a hand-drawn feel.
setup_steps: Open the app → start drawing immediately
Use the library for pre-made shapes and icons
Collaborate in real-time by sharing the room link
Export as PNG or SVG

apps.name: Draw.io
apps.description: Online diagramming and whiteboarding tool for creating flowcharts, diagrams, and vector graphics.

education.quick_start: Draw.io is a diagramming tool for flowcharts, network diagrams, UML, and more. Integrates with Google Drive, OneDrive, and GitHub.
setup_steps: Open the app → choose where to save your diagrams
Drag shapes from the left panel to create diagrams
Export as PNG, SVG, or PDF
Save to cloud storage or locally

apps.name: 9Router
apps.description: Unlimited FREE AI coding. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Copilot, Antigravity to FREE Claude/GPT/Gemini via 40+ providers. Auto-fallback, RTK -40% tokens, never hit limits.

education.quick_start: 9Router runs on port 20128. After install, open the URL and follow the app's setup wizard.
setup_steps: Open http://localhost:20128/ in your browser
Follow the on-screen setup wizard
Configure the app for your needs
